Cristie Software Ltd is a British software company specializing in IT disaster recovery, backup, and cyber resilience solutions. Headquartered in Stroud, Gloucestershire, the company provides automated system recovery software that integrates with enterprise data backup platforms, including IBM, Dell Technologies, Rubrik, and Cohesity.
History
The roots of the company date back to 1969 with the founding of Cristie Data in Gloucestershire. Initially focused on hardware data storage, the group transitioned toward software-led recovery solutions in the 1990s.
In 2007, Cristie Software was established as a separate entity from Cristie Data to focus on software development and the expansion of its Bare-metal restore (BMR) intellectual property. During this period, the company increased investment in R&D, expanded its international operations, and extended technical integration with major enterprise backup software providers. The company holds several patents in the fields of automated bare metal recovery of computers and operating systems and methods to automatically correct and improve system recovery and replication processes.
Cristie Software acquired SysBack, an IBM-developed AIX backup and recovery solution, in 2018. The company continues to develop and support the software.
In February 2023, the company expanded its portfolio of system recovery technologies for Linux, IBM AIX, and Solaris-based virtual and physical systems through the acquisition of Storix, Inc. Cristie introduced Continuous Recovery Assurance and Clean Room Recovery architectures in July 2025 to provide isolated, automated validation of system recovery and backup data.
Technical partnerships
Throughout its history, Cristie Software has maintained strategic development partnerships with major technology firms. Its BMR technology has been developed to integrate with several global enterprise data backup solutions, most notably IBM Storage Protect (formerly IBM Tivoli Storage Manager (TSM)), Dell Technologies NetWorker, Dell Technologies Avamar, Dell Technologies PowerProtect Data Manager, Cohesity Data Protect, and Rubrik Security Cloud.
Products
The company's product line is categorized into platform-integrated recovery, standalone backup and recovery, computer system replication and migration, and cyber resilience orchestration.
BMR Suite
* ABMR / NBMR / PBMR: The BMR suite includes integrations with Dell Technologies backup platforms such as Avamar, NetWorker, and PowerProtect Data Manager.
* TBMR: Integrated recovery for IBM Storage Protect and IBM Storage Defender.
* CoBMR / RBMR: Integrated recovery for Cohesity DataProtect and Rubrik Security Cloud.
System Replication & Migration
The company's system migration tool CloneManager was presented at the IBM TSM-Symposium 2015 in Dresden. The product was extended in 2016 to include real-time replication capabilities, enabling the creation of hot-standby live systems that can be activated in the event of a disaster.
Cyber Resilience
* Continuous Recovery Assurance (CRA): An orchestration tool that automates the testing of backups via scheduled recovery simulations.
* Clean Room Recovery: A software architecture that automates system restoration into an isolated network environment for malware scanning and forensic validation.
